# BTMEDYA

> BTMEDYA is a Turkish news, media production and AI laboratory brand focused on Balıkesir and digital media production.

## Primary site
- https://btmedya.com.tr/

## Main sections
News
- https://btmedya.com.tr/haberler/ : BTMEDYA news archive
- https://btmedya.com.tr/haberler/balikesir/ : Balıkesir local news (also: gundem, ekonomi, kultur, egitim, saglik, spor, teknoloji under /haberler/<category>/)

Services
- https://btmedya.com.tr/hizmetler/ : services overview
- https://btmedya.com.tr/video-produksiyon/ : video production
- https://btmedya.com.tr/sosyal-medya/ : social media management
- https://btmedya.com.tr/reklam-ve-sponsorluk/ : advertising and sponsorship
- https://btmedya.com.tr/whatsapp-katalog/ : 12-service catalog in 5 groups (social media, content and design, AI solutions, legal and health communication, brand and web); pricing by written quote
- https://btmedya.com.tr/teklif-al/ : request a quote

Programs and portfolio
- https://btmedya.com.tr/portfoy/ : media production portfolio
- https://btmedya.com.tr/portfoy/buse-tuncay/ : journalist and portfolio profile

AI LAB

Corporate

## Editorial and media policy
- Original BTMEDYA reporting and user-owned/licensed media are presented as real production.
- AI-generated media is separated and explicitly labeled AI ÜRETİMİ.
- Third-party reporting is summarized with attribution and source URL rather than copied wholesale.
- Historical archive dates are preserved and are not presented as current facts.
- Unknown provenance or unclear licensing is not published as production media.
